description: Capabilities for the About window (`?win=about`): read diagnostics, listen for events, drag itself by its title bar, and hide itself when the user closes it. `core:window:allow-hide` is what lets the × button and Escape dismiss the window — without it the hide call is denied by the ACL. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is what makes the `data-tauri-drag-region` title actually move this frameless window.
